svg.title: ORB Gold | Execution robustness remained conditional on stress
svg.desc: Separate XAUUSD2 Phase 8C lineage; December of each segment is burnoff. Mild: 100 ms +0.01R; CORE: 250 ms +0.025R; Severe: 500 ms +0.05R. Normalized shocks, not measured live slippage. A/C passed full CORE gates in each segment; B failed Discovery. All severe Discovery means ≤0. Scenario categories are connected to aid comparison; they are neither a time series nor one continuous cost model. No money-parity inference.
